international.title: Antisemitism adviser to launch inquiry into ‘hostile work environment’ at BBC
international.summary: John Mann says decision comes after hearing ‘disturbing’ accounts by Jewish staff about discrimination against them UK politics live – latest updates The government’s independent adviser on antisemitism has said he is launching an investigation into the BBC after hearing “disturbing” accounts by Jewish staff about discrimination against them. John Mann, the Labour peer and former MP, said BBC whistleblowers had told him that they faced a “hostile work environment” at the broadcaster and that his previous warnings to its management had gone unheeded.
